1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutLineCharts
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FiniteJunctions

4 
5 /-! The only cut points not yet described by a straight-line neighborhood
6 belong to a finite set: original vertices and targets with at least three routes. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set
11 
12 /-- The finite exceptional set for the regular cut-line neighborhoods. -/
13 def cutExceptions (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : Set (frontier P.body) :=
14   P.junctions a ∪ {b | (b : Space) ∈ P.vertices ∧ b ≠ a}
15 
16 namespace SixVertexGraph
17 
18 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
19   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
20     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
21 
22 include graph small_faces in
23 theorem cutExceptions_finite (a : frontier P.body) : (P.cutExceptions a).Finite := by
24   have vertices_finite := P.vertices.finite_toSet.preimage
25     (f := fun b : frontier P.body => (b : Space)) Subtype.val_injective.injOn
26   exact (graph.junctions_finite small_faces a).union (vertices_finite.subset (fun _ h => h.1))
27 
28 include graph small_faces in
29 /-- Every remaining cut point has exactly two routes and a flat chart of its full cut line. -/
30 theorem regular_cut_point (a b : frontier P.body) (cut : b ∈ P.cutSet a)
31     (regular : b ∉ P.cutExceptions a) :
32     Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) = 2 ∧ Nonempty (P.CutLineChart a b) := by
33   have different : a ≠ b := by
34     rintro rfl
35     exact P.source_not_cutSet a cut
36   have not_vertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices := fun vertex => regular (Or.inr ⟨vertex, different.symm⟩)
37   have multiple : (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a := cut.resolve_right (fun h => not_vertex h.1)
38   have not_unique := ((P.multiple_routes_iff_fiber a b).mp multiple).2
39   have lower : ¬ (P.geodesicFiber a b).ncard ≤ 1 := by
40     intro bound
41     exact not_unique ((ncard_le_one (graph.geodesicFiber_finite small_faces a b different)).mp bound)
42   have upper : ¬ 2 < Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) := fun many =>
43     regular (Or.inl ((graph.junction_iff_route_count small_faces a b different).mpr many))
44   have two : Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) = 2 := by
45     change ¬ Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) ≤ 1 at lower
46     omega
47   exact ⟨two, graph.cut_line_chart small_faces a b different not_vertex two⟩
48 
49 end SixVertexGraph
50 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
